сотворити: poetic	to create, to do, to make, to produce
провести: colloquial	to cheat, to take in, to trick, to fool (:somebody)
вилітати: colloquial	to get the boot, to be kicked out
зносити: colloquial	to lift, to lift up, to raise (elevate to a higher position)
кунтуш: historical	type of outer garment worn by the Hungarian, Polish, Belarusian, Lithuanian, and Ukrainian male nobility
скиглити: colloquial	to whine (make a sound resembling a high-pitched cry) (said of a mechanism or machine)
візитирка: dialectal	doorhole, door viewer (of jail cell)
